summary: October 28, 2025 CVE fixes: CVE-2025-59682 (python-django archive.extract directory traversal), CVE-2025-9908 and CVE-2025-9907 (EDA event streams exposing sensitive internal headers, including in test mode), CVE-2025-59343 (tar-fs symlink validation bypass in the UI) and CVE-2025-58754 (Axios DoS in the UI).
questions: Which CVEs were fixed in the October 28, 2025 AAP patch?
Event stream test mode exposes sensitive headers
Does AAP fix the Axios CVE-2025-58754?

answer_card.title: CVEs fixed in AAP 2.6 patch October 28, 2025
answer_card.answer_md:
- **CVE-2025-59682** `python-django`: partial directory traversal via `archive.extract()`
- **CVE-2025-9908** `event-driven-ansible`: sensitive internal headers disclosed in event streams
- **CVE-2025-9907** `event-driven-ansible`: event stream test mode exposes sensitive headers
- **CVE-2025-59343** `automation-platform-ui`: tar-fs symlink validation bypass
- **CVE-2025-58754** `automation-platform-ui`: Axios DoS via missing data size check
